title_en: Notice of the Office of the Central Committee for Comprehensive Management of Social Public Security, the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the Ministry of Justice on Printing and Distributing the Opinions on Strengthening and Regulating the Work of Serving Sentences Outside Prison
full_text_en:
Office of the Central Committee for Comprehensive Management of Social Security

Supreme People's Court Supreme People's Procuratorate

Ministry of Public Security Ministry of Justice

Circular on Issuing the Opinions on Strengthening and Regulating the Work of Execution Outside Prison

Gao Jian Hui (2009) No. 3

The Offices of the Central Committee for Comprehensive Management of Social Security, the High People's Courts, the People's Procuratorates, the Public Security Departments (Bureaus), and the Judicial Departments (Bureaus) of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Office of the Central Committee for Comprehensive Management of Social Security of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps; the Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region in the Production and Construction Corps; the People's Procuratorate of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps; the Public Security Bureau, the Judicial Bureau, and the Prison Administration Bureau of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

To strengthen and regulate the work of execution outside prison, the Office of the Central Committee for Comprehensive Management of Social Security, the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the Ministry of Justice have formulated the Opinions on Strengthening and Regulating the Work of Execution Outside Prison, which are hereby issued to you for compliance and implementation.

June 25, 2009

Opinions on Strengthening and Regulating the Work of Execution Outside Prison

To strengthen and regulate the delivery for execution, supervision and management, and procuratorial supervision over criminals sentenced to public surveillance, deprivation of political rights, probation, parole, or temporary service of sentence outside prison, and to ensure the correct execution of punishments, in accordance with the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Prison Law of the People's Republic of China, the Public Security Administration Punishments Law of the People's Republic of China, and other relevant provisions, and in light of actual work, the following opinions are proposed:

I. Strengthening and Regulating the Delivery for Execution of Execution Outside Prison

1. When a People's Court imposes a sentence of public surveillance, deprivation of political rights alone, or probation, it shall, within five working days after the judgment or ruling takes effect, verify the criminal's place of residence and serve the judgment, ruling, and execution notice to the competent department of the county-level public security organ at the criminal's place of residence, and send a copy to the prison and detention center supervision department of the county-level People's Procuratorate at the criminal's place of residence.

2. When a prison administration authority or public security organ decides that a criminal is to serve a sentence temporarily outside prison, the prison or detention center responsible for delivery shall escort the criminal to his or her place of residence, complete the handover procedures with the county-level public security organ at the criminal's place of residence, and send copies of the decision on temporary service of sentence outside prison and other legal documents to the competent department of the county-level public security organ and the prison and detention center supervision department of the county-level People's Procuratorate at the criminal's place of residence.

3. If a criminal's place of serving the sentence is not in the same province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government as his or her place of residence, and the criminal needs to return to his or her place of residence to serve the sentence temporarily outside prison, the provincial-level prison administration authority or public security organ's prison and detention center management department at the place of serving the sentence shall notify in writing the corresponding prison administration authority or public security organ's prison and detention center management department at the criminal's place of residence, which shall designate a prison or detention center to receive the criminal's file, be responsible for handling procedures such as re-imprisonment upon the disappearance of the conditions for temporary service of sentence outside prison, and release upon completion of the sentence, and notify the competent department of the county-level public security organ and the prison and detention center supervision department of the county-level People's Procuratorate at the criminal's place of residence.

4. For a criminal for whom the People's Court decides to serve a sentence temporarily outside prison, if the criminal was detained before the judgment or ruling took effect, the public security organ shall handle the handover in accordance with relevant provisions. If the criminal was not detained before the judgment or ruling took effect, the People's Court shall notify the county-level public security organ at the criminal's place of residence to execute the decision. The People's Court shall, within five working days after making the decision for temporary service of sentence outside prison, serve the decision and the judgment, ruling, and execution notice to the competent department of the county-level public security organ at the criminal's place of residence, and send a copy to the prison and detention center supervision department of the county-level People's Procuratorate at the criminal's place of residence.

5. For a criminal granted parole, the People's Court shall serve the parole ruling to the executing authority that proposed the parole and the People's Procuratorate responsible for prison and detention center supervision tasks. The prison or detention center shall verify the criminal's place of residence and, within five working days after releasing the criminal, serve copies of the parole certificate, judgment, ruling, and other legal documents to the competent department of the county-level public security organ at the criminal's place of residence, and send copies to the prison and detention center supervision department of the county-level People's Procuratorate at the criminal's place of residence. For a criminal who is additionally subject to deprivation of political rights after the completion of the principal punishment, the prison or detention center shall verify the criminal's place of residence and, one month before releasing the criminal, serve the notice of release upon completion of sentence, the judgment and ruling under which the supplementary punishment of deprivation of political rights is executed, and other legal documents to the competent department of the county-level public security organ at the criminal's place of residence, and send copies to the prison and detention center supervision department of the county-level People's Procuratorate at the criminal's place of residence.

6. After a judgment or ruling is made for a criminal sentenced to public surveillance, deprivation of political rights, or probation, and when a criminal granted parole or a criminal subject to additional deprivation of political rights after completion of the principal punishment is released from prison, the People's Court, prison, or detention center shall inform the criminal in writing that he or she must report to the local public security police station on time, and of the legal consequences for failing to report on time. The criminal shall sign the notification letter. From the date the People's Court's judgment or ruling takes effect or the date the prison or detention center releases the criminal, those who are adjudicated or serve their sentence or are detained within the same province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government shall report within ten days; those who are adjudicated or serve their sentence or are detained in another province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government shall report within twenty days. The notification letter shall be made in triplicate: one copy shall be given to the criminal subject to execution outside prison, one copy shall be sent to the county-level public security organ at the place of execution, and one copy shall be retained by the notifying authority.

7. After receiving the legal documents served by the People's Court, prison, or detention center, the public security organ at the place of execution shall, within five working days, return a receipt of service.

II. Strengthening and Regulating the Supervision and Management of Criminals Subject to Execution Outside Prison

8. If a criminal subject to execution outside prison fails to report within the prescribed time, the public security police station shall report this to the competent department of the county-level public security organ, which shall notify the authority that made the judgment, ruling, or decision.

9. If the public security organ at the place of execution believes that the conditions for a criminal's temporary service of sentence outside prison have disappeared, it shall promptly make a written suggestion to the authority that approved or decided the temporary service of sentence outside prison, or to the superior competent authority of the prison that received the criminal's file, for re-imprisonment. If the approving or deciding authority, or the superior competent authority of the prison that received the criminal's file, upon review, deems re-imprisonment necessary, it shall issue a decision on re-imprisonment, which shall be served separately to the public security organ at the place of execution and the prison responsible for re-imprisonment. After receiving the decision on re-imprisonment, the public security organ at the place of execution shall immediately detain the criminal and notify the prison to take custody of the criminal for re-imprisonment.

For a criminal approved for temporary service of sentence outside prison by the public security organ, if the conditions for temporary service of sentence outside prison disappear, the public security organ at the place of execution shall promptly issue a notice of re-imprisonment, notifying the detention center responsible for re-imprisonment to immediately take the criminal into custody for execution.

10. If a criminal subject to temporary service of sentence outside prison, without approval, leaves the city or county where he or she resides, refuses to correct after warning, or refuses to report his or her whereabouts or is missing, the public security organ may, in accordance with relevant procedures, place the criminal on an online wanted list.

11. If a criminal for whom the People's Court decided temporary service of sentence outside prison is to be re-imprisoned, the public security organ at the criminal's place of residence shall, based on the People's Court's decision, send the criminal to a prison near the place of temporary service of sentence outside prison if the remaining sentence is more than one year, or to the detention center at the place of temporary service of sentence outside prison for execution on behalf of the prison if the remaining sentence is one year or less.

12. If a criminal subject to temporary service of sentence outside prison, without approval, leaves the city or county where he or she resides, refuses to correct after warning, or refuses to report his or her whereabouts or is missing, or uses self-harm, self-mutilation, deception, bribery, or other means to obtain or delay temporary service of sentence outside prison, or fails to submit medical or diagnostic records on time without just cause on two or more occasions, the approving or deciding authority shall, based on the suggestion of the public security organ at the place of execution, promptly decide to re-imprison the criminal.

If a criminal approved for temporary service of sentence outside prison by the public security organ falls into any of the above circumstances, the public security organ at the place of execution shall promptly decide to re-imprison the criminal.

13. The public security organ shall establish a system for assessing and rewarding and punishing criminals subject to execution outside prison. Based on the assessment results, commendations and rewards shall be given to those who behave well; for those who meet the legal conditions for commutation of sentence, a suggestion for commutation shall be proposed in accordance with the law, and the People's Court shall rule in accordance with the law. A copy of the executing authority's suggestion for commutation and a copy of the People's Court's ruling on commutation shall be sent to the prison and detention center supervision department of the People's Procuratorate at the same level.

14. If a criminal subject to execution outside prison, during the period of execution or probation, violates laws, administrative regulations, or the relevant provisions on supervision and management of the public security department of the State Council, the public security organ shall impose a public security administration punishment in accordance with Article 60 of the Public Security Administration Punishments Law of the People's Republic of China.

15. If a criminal sentenced to probation or parole, during the probation or parole period, falls into any of the following circumstances, the public security organ at the place of execution at the same level as the People's Court that rendered the original judgment shall propose the revocation of the probation or parole:

(1) The People's Court, prison, or detention center has already informed the criminal in writing to report to the public security organ at the place of execution on time, but the criminal fails to report within the prescribed time and has been out of supervision for more than three months;

(2) Without the approval of the public security organ at the place of execution, the criminal leaves the city or county where he or she resides or changes residence, and has been out of supervision for more than three months;

(3) The criminal fails to report his or her activities in accordance with the regulations of the public security organ at the place of execution or fails to comply with the executing authority's regulations on meeting visitors, and after three instances of education still refuses to correct;

(4) There are other violations of laws, administrative regulations, or the provisions of the public security department of the State Council on the supervision and management of probation or parole, with serious circumstances.

16. After the People's Court rules to revoke probation or parole, the public security organ at the place of execution shall promptly send the criminal to a prison or detention center for re-imprisonment. If a criminal whose probation or parole has been revoked and who has been ordered to be re-imprisoned is missing, the public security organ may, in accordance with relevant procedures, place the criminal on an online wanted list.

A copy of the public security organ's suggestion to revoke probation or parole and a copy of the People's Court's ruling to revoke probation or parole shall be sent to the prison and detention center supervision department of the People's Procuratorate at the criminal's place of residence.

17. If a criminal subject to execution outside prison dies during the period of probation, parole, temporary service of sentence outside prison, public surveillance, or deprivation of political rights, the public security organ shall, after verifying the circumstances, notify the People's Court that rendered the original judgment, the prison or detention center that originally held the criminal, or the prison or detention center that received the criminal's file, as well as the prison and detention center supervision department of the county-level People's Procuratorate at the place of execution.

18. When the period of execution for a criminal sentenced to public surveillance or deprivation of political rights expires, the public security organ shall notify the criminal in person and publicly announce the removal of public surveillance or restoration of political rights to his or her unit or the residents of his or her place of residence. For a criminal sentenced to probation whose probation period expires and the original sentence is no longer executed, the public security organ shall make an announcement to the criminal and his or her unit or the residents of his or her place of residence, and notify the People's Court that rendered the original judgment. For a criminal granted parole whose parole period expires and the original sentence is fully executed, the public security organ shall make an announcement to the criminal and his or her unit or the residents of his or her place of residence, and notify the People's Court that rendered the original ruling and the prison or detention center that originally executed the sentence.

19. When the sentence of a criminal subject to temporary service of sentence outside prison expires, the public security organ at the place of execution shall promptly notify the prison or detention center that originally held the criminal, or the prison or detention center that received the criminal's file, to handle the release procedures on time. For a criminal for whom the People's Court decided temporary service of sentence outside prison, when the sentence expires, the public security organ at the place of execution shall notify the People's Court that rendered the original judgment and the county-level People's Procuratorate at the place of execution, and handle the release procedures on time.

III. Strengthening and Regulating Procuratorial Supervision over Execution Outside Prison

20. The People's Procuratorate shall exercise legal supervision over the delivery for execution and the supervision and management of criminals subject to execution outside prison by the People's Court, public security organs, prisons, and detention centers. If any illegal or non-compliant activities are discovered, corrective opinions shall be promptly issued.

21. The county-level People's Procuratorate shall register one by one the criminals delivered for execution to the jurisdiction of its county (city, district, banner) by the People's Court, prisons, and detention centers, and establish a procuratorial ledger for the execution outside prison of criminals.

22. In procuratorial work concerning execution outside prison, the People's Procuratorate shall, in accordance with relevant provisions, seriously handle the complaints and appeals of criminals subject to execution outside prison, properly address their reported issues, and protect their lawful rights and interests in accordance with the law.

23. The People's Procuratorate shall conduct procuratorial work on execution outside prison through a combination of regular and irregular methods, and, based on the problems identified and the specific circumstances, shall issue a notice of correction of illegality, a procuratorial recommendation letter, or propose oral corrective opinions. If the delivery executing authority and the executing authority have no objection to the corrective opinions or procuratorial recommendations proposed by the People's Procuratorate, they shall make corrections within fifteen days and inform the People's Procuratorate of the correction result. If they have objections to the corrective opinions or procuratorial recommendations, they shall raise the objection to the People's Procuratorate within seven days after receiving the corrective opinions or procuratorial recommendations from the People's Procuratorate. The People's Procuratorate shall review the case and make a review decision within seven days. If the reviewing conclusion is still contested, the matter shall be submitted to the People's Procuratorate at the next higher level for review, and the People's Procuratorate at the next higher level shall make a review decision within seven days.

24. If the People's Procuratorate discovers any of the following circumstances, it shall propose corrective opinions:

(1) The People's Court, prison, or detention center fails to serve legal documents concerning execution outside prison in accordance with the law, fails to deliver the criminal for execution in accordance with the law, or fails to inform the criminal of his or her rights and obligations in accordance with the law;

(2) After receiving a suggestion from a relevant authority for revoking probation, parole, or temporary service of sentence outside prison for a criminal subject to execution outside prison, the People's Court fails to conduct a review, make a ruling, or issue a decision in accordance with the law;

(3) The public security organ fails to take timely custody of a criminal subject to execution outside prison, or fails to implement supervisory responsibilities or measures for a criminal subject to execution outside prison;

(4) The public security organ fails to impose punishment in accordance with the law on a criminal subject to execution outside prison who has violated the law, or fails to propose punishment where punishment should be imposed in accordance with the law;

(5) The public security organ or prison administration authority should make a decision to re-imprison a criminal but fails to do so;

(6) The prison or detention center should take a criminal into custody for re-imprisonment but fails to do so;

(7) The public security organ fails to propose commutation of sentence for a criminal subject to execution outside prison who is eligible for commutation in accordance with the law, or proposes commutation improperly;

(8) The People's Court fails to rule on commutation of sentence for a criminal subject to execution outside prison who is eligible for commutation in accordance with the law, or the commutation ruling is improper;

(9) The public security organ, prison, or detention center fails to handle relevant procedures and perform relevant formalities on time upon expiration of the sentence or probation period of a criminal subject to execution outside prison;

(10) The People's Court, public security organ, prison, or detention center infringes upon the lawful rights and interests of a criminal during the process of delivery for execution or supervision and management of a criminal subject to execution outside prison;

(11) A criminal subject to execution outside prison is out of supervision or omitted from supervision;

(12) Other circumstances in which corrective opinions should be proposed in accordance with the law.

25. If a criminal subject to execution outside prison is suspected of committing a crime during the period of execution outside prison, and the public security organ should file a case in accordance with the law but fails to do so, the People's Procuratorate shall handle the matter in accordance with Article 87 of the Criminal Procedure of the People's Republic of China.

IV. Strengthening Comprehensive Management of Execution Outside Prison

26. The comprehensive management of social security departments at all levels, the People's Courts, the People's Procuratorates, the public security organs, and the judicial administrative organs shall fully recognize the significant importance of strengthening and regulating the work of execution outside prison for preventing and correcting the problems of criminals subject to execution outside prison being out of supervision or omitted from supervision, preventing and reducing recidivism, and promoting social harmony and stability, and shall strengthen the leadership and inspection of this work; in all aspects of delivery for execution, supervision and management, procuratorial supervision, and comprehensive management evaluation of execution outside prison, they shall perform their duties within their respective responsibilities according to the division of labor, forming a work pattern in which each performs its own duties, bears its own responsibilities, collaborates and cooperates, and works together to manage. The comprehensive management of social security departments at all levels shall, together with the People's Procuratorates, conduct evaluations of execution outside prison, and take this as an important part of performance evaluation, strengthen accountability, and ensure that these opinions are implemented.

27. The comprehensive management of social security departments at all levels, the People's Courts, the People's Procuratorates, the public security organs, and the judicial administrative organs shall hold regular joint meetings annually to report on relevant situations and study and resolve issues in the work of execution outside prison. The delivery executing authority and the county-level public security organ shall, every six months, report in writing the delivery for execution and supervision and management of criminals subject to execution outside prison to the comprehensive management of social security department and the prison and detention center supervision department of the People's Procuratorate at the same level.

28. All provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall, in accordance with the unified deployment of relevant central departments, conscientiously carry out and deeply promote the pilot work of community corrections, strengthen and regulate the supervision, management, and educational correction of community inmates, and strive to give full play to the important role of community corrections in educating and reforming criminals and preventing recidivism. The delivery for execution and supervision and management of community inmates in pilot areas for community corrections shall be carried out with reference to these opinions and in accordance with relevant provisions on community corrections.
